verdict.rationale: E2B gives users lifecycle controls that shape how long sandbox data lives: sandboxes can be killed at any time, timeouts can be set or reset, and shutdown, listing (including paused) and snapshot management are available via the CLI. Paused sandboxes are kept indefinitely with no automatic deletion, and self-hosting or BYOC gives control over where data resides. However, there is no documented data-retention policy and no explicit guarantee that data is deleted. Missing for 10: a documented retention policy or retention windows, explicit deletion guarantees for paused sandboxes, snapshots and logs, account-level data deletion controls, and independent corroboration.
